reviews.text: I left my dog ​​with them for a few days and the follow-up was amazing. They kept me updated on how she was doing, and when I got home she seemed calm. I highly recommend them; I will definitely use their service again.
Highly recommended. Tita had a wonderful time, so much so that she didn't want to go home. We will definitely choose them again for future care.

First time we left at La Fosca and everything was great, they sent us photos throughout the day, and they were attentive at all times on WhatsApp and with us.
We will repeat
They looked after my two dogs for a weekend and have been sending me lots of photos to let me know how they were doing! Excellent caregivers ❤️

Per Barcelona's service was excellent!!! I have an asthmatic kitten, and every time I went on a trip it was a worry, but Ana has always taken wonderful care of him. She sends us photos and a report like this every day, and it's so reassuring to know that you're not only leaving him with someone responsible, but that as a veterinarian, she'll know how to handle any problem. Thank you, Ana, for taking care of Carmelito!!! ❤️

My dog ​​stayed with them for 4 days and they were very professional. They sent me videos and photos of her constantly ❤️ We will definitely use them again. For those who are afraid to leave their dogs with strangers, I highly recommend them!!

Thank you 😇

We are so happy and grateful to Ana for taking care of our little border collie puppy. She had a wonderful time and it helped her mature a lot because she spent time with other dogs! Ana was lovely and shared lots of photos and updates with us throughout the process! We will definitely be back many times! Thank you, Ana!!
Thank you so much Ana and Fede for taking care of my baby girl!! Every time I take her, she's so happy, which shows how well you treat her!!
Excellent service, lovely staff, 100% professional and highly recommended

Verónica was super sweet with both my doggies, she walked them twice a day while I was at work. They loved her and she helped them calm down before their walk(they get excited around walk time) which was super helpful, she also sent pictures and videos which I appreciate because I knew they were well taken care of! ❤️❤️❤️

1000% recommended!! I'm not from Barcelona, ​​I needed a place to leave my babies during the day while I attended my sister's thesis defense. From the very first moment, they were incredibly accommodating and super easy to coordinate. They also sent videos and photos constantly to make sure my two little ones were okay 🥰 Thank you so much for everything!!

We are very happy with how Ana has taken care of our dog Kayla. Professional and attentive, she has kept us updated with photos and videos of Kayla's condition, and it's a great relief for us to know we can count on her. Highly recommended.
Excellent care for my poodle, who's like a son to me. Thank you, Ana!
EXCELLENT!!! THEY'RE BETTER THAN ME...
The best!

Excellent care for my dog... they take him for walks, and Ana is very sweet.
My peace of mind is complete, every day!
100% recommended.
I left my dog ​​Tokio there and she was very well taken care of, happy and content. I highly recommend it.
Super practical

We have left our dog with Ana many times and that too for sometimes 1 month at a time. Ana treats our dog like her own family and even when we have to leave her for a long time, we never doubt how much she is being loved and taken care of. While we are away, she send us pictures and updates every day. She is very trustworthy and I highly recommend having your dog stay with her :)

I already knew Ana because she's Olivia's vet, so I expected my dog ​​to be very well cared for, but I was even more pleasantly surprised by the love and attention she received. I trust her completely and highly recommend her.

They could put on their website that they don't accept dogs over 20kg, which I find shameful. It's one thing to not want to accept many dogs, that's perfectly legitimate, but it's another to deny service because the dog weighs more than 20kg. They could have said that my dog ​​is heavy and that they probably couldn't handle him, and I would have accepted him more readily (I have a mastiff mix that weighs 70kg, which is why I understand that not everyone can manage him). Anyway, a disappointment.

It was the first time we'd left our dog Mario for so many days, so we were a little nervous. We were delighted with how they treated him; they sent us photos all day, and Mario looked so happy. They definitely treated him just like he did at home; you can see the love they have for pets ❤️
Excellent service and attention. Anabella is a true professional.
Spectacular attention and care, thank you
A great place to leave your pet. Very safe and reliable.

We are delighted with Ana's care for our dog, India. We've left her with her many times, and it shows in the love and professionalism with which she treats her. They always send us photos, videos, and messages telling us what she's been up to and how her day went. 100% recommended ❤️❤️
